2609.01345.title: Cheap Verifiers, Large Blind Spots: Measuring the Reliability Cost of Cost-Saving Cascades
2609.01345.paper_summary: Inference cascades cut cost by answering most queries with a cheap model and escalating a hard tail to a frontier model that acts as verifier. A natural extension closes the loop: fine-tune the cheap student on the verifier's rejections so the escalation rate, and cost, fall each round. We measure this loop on real LLMs and report four findings. First, the verifier's blind spot, the fraction of the student's wrong answers it accepts, is large and moves adversarially: it grows with student capability ($β$ from 0.12 to 0.55 as the student scales 0.5B to 32B) and shrinks with verifier capability, so it is worst in the cheap-student, cheap-verifier regime cascades exist to create. Second, buying it away returns the saving: a frontier verifier drives $β$ to about 0.05 but then escalates on 46% of hard-MATH queries against a 39% true error rate, paying the frontier price on nearly half of all traffic. Third, naive corrective fine-tuning on the verifier-rejected tail does not improve the small student but degrades and ultimately collapses it, across every teacher we tried (cross-family and same-family), so at this scale the self-improving loop is self-defeating. Fourth, through all of this the cascade's own dashboard, every metric computed through the verifier, reads a flat 3% error while true delivered error swings up to 32%: the system is blind to its own degradation by construction. We then give the theory that explains the blindness, a two-population conservation law, $ε_\infty \lesssim q_0 β_0$, under which every in-loop metric improves while true quality does not, and a synthetic study that validates the mechanism. The practical conclusion: the reliability of a self-improving cascade cannot be read from any metric computed through its own verifier.
2609.01345.paper_summary_zh: 推理級聯透過使用廉價模型回答大多數查詢並將難題升級到作為驗證者的前沿模型來降低成本。自然的擴展閉合了這個循環：對驗證者拒絕的情況進行微調廉價學生，使得每一輪的升級率和成本都下降。我們在真實的 LLM 上測量這個循環並報告四個發現。首先，驗證者的盲點，即學生錯誤答案被接受的比例，既大又呈對抗性：隨著學生能力的增強（$β$ 從 0.12 增長到 0.55，當學生從 0.5B 擴展到 32B），這一比例也在增長，並且隨著驗證者能力的增強而縮小，因此在廉價學生、廉價驗證者的體系中，情況最糟。第二，將其買走可以獲得節省：一個前沿驗證者將 $β$ 驅動到約 0.05，但隨後在 46% 的難數學查詢中升級，而真實錯誤率為 39%，在幾乎一半的所有流量中支付前沿價格。第三，對驗證者拒絕的尾部進行天真的修正微調並未改善小型學生，反而使其退化並最終崩潰，這一情況在我們嘗試的每一位教師中（跨家族和同家族）都存在，因此在這個規模下，自我改善的循環是自我挫敗的。第四，在這一切中，級聯自身的儀表板，即通過驗證者計算的每一個指標，顯示出平坦的 3% 錯誤，而真實交付的錯誤率則高達 32%：該系統在構建上對自身的退化是盲目的。我們接著給出解釋盲點的理論，一個雙人口保守定律，$ε_\infty \lesssim q_0 β_0$，根據該定律，循環中的每一個指標都在改善，而真實質量卻沒有，並且提供了一個合成研究來驗證這一機制。實際結論是：自我改善級聯的可靠性無法從通過其自身驗證者計算的任何指標中讀取。
